name: Görkem Erol
title: Senior Product Engineer
summary: AI-native Senior Product Engineer (9+ years) who has fully rebuilt the way software gets built around agentic coding and LLM-assisted workflows: ships production-caliber applications from scratch in a week, and delivered a full country expansion (app, backend, infrastructure) as sole engineer using AI-first tooling. Track record spans enterprise security (clients including Mastercard), cross-platform mobile apps, backend systems, and Web3 platforms used by tens of thousands of active users across multiple countries. Takes full product ownership: defines scope, drives architecture, leads engineering teams, and is accountable for what ships. Works best in teams that move fast and own what they build.

bullets: Own Flovi's Spain market expansion end-to-end as sole engineer, architecting and building the Flutter app and full Laravel/PostgreSQL backend infrastructure for a new country from scratch, at a pace made possible by an AI-first development workflow.
Drove AI-first development adoption across the team, making agentic coding and LLM-assisted tooling part of the standard build workflow.
Built the driver acquisition web funnel powering growth in new markets, handling 100% of new driver onboarding.
Ship full-stack features weekly across the Laravel backend and Flutter app for Driver Squad, a product operating in 4 countries.
Planned and developed a custom background location tracking package for the Flutter driver app, delivering reliable real-time GPS tracking across Android and iOS.
Rewrote core backend services from Laravel to Nest.js/TypeScript, improving type safety and maintainability across the stack.
Built AI-powered internal tooling that replaced manual ops workflows, freeing the ops team to focus on higher-value work.

Architected and shipped a cross-platform Flutter HRM app with a Laravel backend from zero to App Store launch in under 6 months, onboarding 10,000+ users in the first 3 months, 3x the initial growth target.
Delivered the full mobile HR suite: attendance and time registration, vacation, absence and sick-leave tracking, work plans, payslips, travel expenses, employment documents, and employee handbooks.
Engineered the app as a multi-tenant platform with offline support and feature flags, enabling per-client rollout of capabilities across customer companies.
Built and led a team of 4 engineers, introducing code review standards and clear task ownership that cut review turnaround from days to same-day.
Automated the full build and release pipeline via CodeMagic and GitHub Actions, reducing deployment time from hours to minutes and enabling continuous delivery with zero manual intervention.
Built Swift iOS and macOS security applications used by 20,000+ active users, serving enterprise clients including Mastercard.

Cut security vulnerabilities by 70% through RSA asymmetric encryption and hardened data protection, eliminating an entire class of attack vectors and meeting GDPR requirements across a Fortune 500 client base.
Refactored the Swift/SwiftUI codebase to modular architecture, cutting production defects and speeding up feature delivery.
Designed high-throughput blockchain architecture on Ethereum Layer 2 serving 50,000+ active users, cutting per-transaction gas costs through smart contract optimization and transaction batching.
Built and scaled a Web3 marketplace and IDO platform to 30,000+ users using Nest.js, PostgreSQL, and Web3.js, with on-chain features that drove higher transaction volume and platform revenue.
Led 5 engineers across multiple concurrent blockchain workstreams, shipping every major release on schedule.
Delivered Jira Service Desk and SuiteCRM integrations for enterprise clients, streamlining support operations.
Developed a production-grade QuickBooks integration plugin in JavaScript and PHP, automating financial data reconciliation and saving accounting teams hours of manual work per week.
Extended SuiteCRM's payment processing capabilities with custom-built modules, improving cross-team payment workflows and increasing platform operational efficiency.
Shipped production iOS and Android applications in Flutter from a single unified codebase, reaching thousands of active monthly users across both platforms.
Built platform-native API bridges in Java (Android) and Objective-C (iOS) for real-time communication with peripheral hardware, resulting in lower connection latency and higher device reliability.
Designed and implemented a custom Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) protocol module from scratch, enabling device pairing and data synchronization.
